I’d urgently flag the facts to the manager before 13:30: Claire is authorised but cannot collect until Wednesday, and the letters and photographs are the only copies. I’d ask whether any **valid written permission registered before the date change** is available. The request in the notes is not permission, and the next approval sitting is too late to authorise a change today.

On the facts given, there is no such permission and the manager has directed the full batch to be released. So I would **not change the storage date or quietly omit the box from the manifest**; either would amount to an unauthorised hold. I would release the batch on time, knowing this box will be destroyed, and document that the extension was requested but not approved.

That is a painful outcome, but the unique contents do not give an operator authority to grant an extension, and a later approval cannot make an earlier change valid. Deliberately withholding the manifest would also delay all 60 boxes, contrary to the instruction, without being an authorised way to protect this one. If valid permission were registered before the deadline, I would instead extend it to Wednesday’s collection time and have it moved to reserve storage.
